title: Securing High-Concurrency Ticket Sales: A Framework Based on Microservice
abstract: arXiv:2512.24941v3 Announce Type: replace  Abstract: The railway ticketing system is one of the most important public service infrastructure. In peak periods such as holidays, it is often faced with the challenge of high concurrency scenarios because of a large number of users accessing at the same time. The traditional aggregation architecture can not meet the peak user requirements because of its insufficient fault tolerance and low ability. Therefore, the system needs to use microservice architecture for development, and add multiple security methods to ensure that the system can have good stability and data consistency under high concurrency scenarios, and can respond quickly to user requests. This paper introduces the use of B/S architecture and Spring Cloud to design and develop a railway ticket purchase system that can maintain stability and reliability under high concurrency scenarios, and formulate multiple security design methods for the system. translated_title: 保障高并发售票安全：一种基于微服务的框架
translated_abstract: 铁路售票系统是最重要的公共服务基础设施之一。在节假日等高峰期，由于大量用户同时访问，系统经常面临高并发场景的挑战。传统的聚合式架构由于容错能力不足、承载能力较低，无法满足高峰期用户的需求。因此，系统需要采用微服务架构进行开发，并加入多种安全方法，以确保系统在高并发场景下具有良好的稳定性和数据一致性，并能快速响应用户请求。本文介绍了使用B/S架构和Spring Cloud设计开发一个能够在高并发场景下保持稳定可靠的铁路购票系统，并为该系统制定了多种安全设计方法。该系统集成了……
tldr: 本文提出了一种基于Spring Cloud微服务架构的铁路购票系统设计框架，通过多种安全设计方法保障系统在高并发场景下的稳定性、数据一致性和快速响应能力。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes a railway ticketing system framework based on Spring Cloud microservices, which employs multiple security design methods to ensure system stability, data consistency, and rapid response under high-concurrency scenarios.
